layout_and_spacing.strategy: CONTROL ROOM Grid - Max Information Density
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-64 fixed h-screen border-r border-border bg-surface flex flex-col
layout_and_spacing.surface_treatment: GRID BORDERS - Technical look. Use flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders (border-slate-200), NO drop shadows. Border radius should be rounded-none or rounded-sm.

kpi_card.container: bg-white border border-border p-5 flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-sm
kpi_card.title: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500

data_table.container: w-full border-collapse text-sm bg-white border border-border rounded-sm overflow-hidden
data_table.header_cell: text-left py-3 px-4 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-xs text-slate-700

buttons.primary: bg-[#002FA7] hover:bg-[#00227A] text-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold transition-colors rounded-sm inline-flex items-center justify-center
buttons.secondary: border border-slate-300 hover:border-slate-900 text-slate-900 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold transition-colors rounded-sm inline-flex items-center justify-center

alerts_panel.alert_item: border-l-4 border-red-600 bg-white border-y border-r border-slate-200 p-4 shadow-sm flex items-start gap-3
alerts_panel.title: font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm
alerts_panel.warning_item: border-l-4 border-amber-500 bg-white border-y border-r border-slate-200 p-4 shadow-sm flex items-start gap-3

icons.usage: Use crisp, stroke-width 2 icons. Minimal scale (16px or 20px). NO emojis.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Hard background color changes, no soft fades. High contrast shifts.

logo.description: Minimalist corporate logo black, use as brand identity placeholder in the sidebar or auth screen

auth_background.description: Architectural/Geometric abstract background with contrasting light for the login screen's split-panel design

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case representing their role.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast for all text. The text_primary on background exceeds the 4.5:1 ratio.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a dense 'Control Room' sidebar layout. The sidebar should be fixed width (64) with exact 1px borders.
Implement Shadcn UI components but heavily override their default classes: strip away soft drop shadows (shadow-sm/md/lg) and large border-radii. Enforce rounded-sm or rounded-none.
Use 'Chivo' font-family globally. Maximize visual tension with huge font weights (font-black) for KPI numbers and tiny tracked-out fonts (uppercase tracking-wider) for labels.
Implement the Smart Alerts dashboard panel as a stacked list of high-contrast alert cards (red/amber left borders).
For the Data Editor/Missing values functionality, highlight empty or invalid cells prominently (e.g., using amber/red backgrounds) so analysts spot data gaps instantly.
Never use transparent backgrounds over content; always use solid white or gray surfaces for clear data visibility.
Charts should use solid brand colors without excessive gradients, matching the authoritative Swiss-style design.
